svg.title: Zero-phase special quadrature accuracy versus nonzero-phase convergence and Gauss agreement.
svg.desc: English: Zero-phase special quadrature accuracy versus nonzero-phase convergence and Gauss agreement. 繁體中文：零相位特殊積分精確性、非零相位收斂及 Gauss 積分一致性。

cc:Work.dc:description: Saved integration sensitivity for ZIP M=4, comparing zero phase and load phase pi/8. Panel (a) gives the largest trapezoid-versus-Gauss-128 linear-matrix discrepancy over the declared refinement loads; an exactly zero value would be omitted on the logarithmic axis and retained as zero in the CSV. The zero-phase finite Fourier products have special trapezoid exactness up to roundoff; that property does not establish accuracy at arbitrary phase. Panel (b) gives the largest accepted root-energy difference for Gauss 64 or 256 versus the matched Gauss-128 correction, without plotting the reference's tautological zero. Failed or unpaired comparisons are explicitly counted, not replaced by zero. Agreement of known roots is not enumeration of unknown branches.
